newsitem.title: USA: Legal Research investment cut Q4 margins.
newsitem.headline: Legal Research investment cut Q4 margins.

text.p: Legal Research Center Inc said additional investment in infrastructure from what was originally contemplated reduced margins in the fourth quarter to 38 percent from a historical rate of about 50 percent.
The company said during the quarter it needed the infrastructure to complete its largest multi-jurisdictional survey project.
Legal Research said it expects to recover this investment in 1997 and beyond with new surveys already in production and on order as well as subsequent resales of the original survey.
Earlier on Thursday, the company reported a fourth-quarter loss of $0.35 per share compared to a year-ago loss of $0.10 per share. Revenues rose to $877,965 from $432,394.
